==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Instagram|username=|url=|name=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===External links===
<code><nowiki>{{Instagram|username=|name=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Required parameters'''
*{{Para|username}} Instagram nickname of author
*{{Para|name}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.
Leaving <code>url</code> blank omits the backup link warning and the maintenance categorization.

'''Optional parameters'''
*Backup parameters; see below

===References===
<pre><nowiki>{{Instagram|username=|url=|name=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|archive_blocked=}}</nowiki></pre>

Required parameters
*{{Para|username}} Instagram nickname of author
*{{Para|url}} Permanent URL to Instagram post, excluding the <code><nowiki>https://instagram.com/</nowiki></code> portion.
*{{Para|name}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.

Optional parameters
*{{Para|date}} Date the Instagram post was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} A short excerpt from the citation for quick reference in the article.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Instagram|username=starwars|name=[[Star Wars]]|archivedate=20170601014300}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Instagram|username=starwars|name=[[Star Wars]]|archivedate=20170601014300}}

[&hellip;]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/CgTjc}}</nowiki></code>
